items.title: 61531_Juan Tizol oral history interview
items.q: by Gene Norman for Capital Records -- a 10 inch LP, and Duke was in the booth, because I was there at the session and I remember.

ctx.x: The name of the album was called the Just Jazz All Stars featuring Louie Bellson, but it was done here in Los Angeles while the band was in town. And you're on the record; the people on the record are Willie Smith, Harry Carney, Wardell Gray, Juan Tizol, Clark Terry, Billy Strayhorn, John Graas-- the french horn player -- remember him -- and Wendell Marshall and Louie. And it was recorded

by Gene Norman for Capital Records -- a 10 inch LP, and Duke was in the booth, because I was there at the session and I remember. Billy Strayhorn was playing the piano, and a couple of the tunes are by Louie, but there was one by you called "Rainbow," and you played a solo on it. It's very pretty -- I played it last night. Do you remember that?
